prop_grading.counting: Graded from the recorded predictions in the tracking store: the earliest recorded projection per player and stat, the same pick the track record counts. A row is labelled made before tip-off only where its own timestamp proves it; rows that cannot prove it are graded and labelled, not dropped.
prop_grading.confidence_basis: Most confident ranks the day's projections by how far the model moved from the player's own rolling average -- the mean of his previous 10 recorded games. It is the model's biggest departures from baseline, not a probability, and it is ranked only over rows whose baseline the stored record can prove.
prop_grading.grade_basis: Grades measure the miss against the props model's own holdout error for that stat (MAE): On the number is within half the error, Close within the error, Off within twice it, Way off beyond that. The delta is actual minus projected: positive means the player beat the projection.

aggregates.basis: Prop-model tracking over the whole counted record: every counted projection made before tip-off (the earliest recorded projection per player and stat whose own timestamp proves it was made in time), graded against what the player did. Per stat: the average miss, the average signed miss, and how the grades fall across the bands, beside the model's own holdout error for the stat.
